content: {"like":["Values humor that is subtle and clever rather than over-the-top; appreciates well-acted, well-written sequels that build on previous stories; enjoys movies that provide detailed explanations and thoughtful plot developments; prefers films that balance tension with engaging character dynamics; appreciates content that is entertaining yet not excessively long or repetitive."],"dislike":["Dislikes content that is overly vulgar, offensive, or contains gratuitous gore; avoids movies with choppy editing, weak plot structure, or unnecessary scenes; rejects films that rely on predictable or clichéd tropes; is sensitive to animal cruelty or questionable depictions of violence; steers clear of overacted, exaggerated performances or content with blatant racism or sexism."]}
